embeds.title: BLHA CONSTITUTION
embeds.description: The Constitution is the controlling rules document of the Beer League Hockey Association. Every owner accepts it as a condition of joining and is responsible for knowing it.

fields.name: CURRENT DOCUMENT
fields.value:
**Version:** 2.2 • Charter Edition
**Effective:** Season 2027 (inaugural season 2027–28)
**Last amended:** Not yet amended

fields.name: HOW DATES WORK
fields.value: The Constitution defines deadlines by formula. Exact dates for each season are published in **league-calendar** within 14 days after the NHL releases its schedule.

fields.name: CHANGING THE RULES
fields.value: Material amendments need 8 of 12 franchise votes, are held only in the offseason, and must pass before the dues deadline of the season they first apply to (Article XX). The first amendment vote can happen after Season 2027.

fields.name: HOW TO USE THIS CHANNEL
fields.value: The current Constitution, adopted amendments and the version history live here. Questions about what a rule means go to **rules-questions**.

fields.name: AUTHORITY
fields.value: Fantrax controls gameplay records and transactions. The Constitution controls league rules and governance. The newest published version controls.
